JASSUB 2.5.16 (https://github.com/ThaUnknown/jassub), bundled with esbuild by
crates/flex-web/scripts/vendor-jassub.sh. Licenses: LGPL-2.1-or-later AND (FTL OR GPL-2.0-or-later) AND MIT AND MIT-Modern-Variant AND ISC AND NTP AND Zlib AND BSL-1.0.
The WebAssembly is libass and its dependencies (FreeType, HarfBuzz, FriBidi, ...).
default.woff2 is JASSUB's default font (Liberation Sans, SIL Open Font License).
